title.purpose: The page name, once per page.

panel-title.purpose: Names a panel; the count follows in muted weight.

body.purpose: Table cells, descriptions and form values.

identifier.purpose: GSTIN, PAN, invoice and policy numbers only.

shadows.name: drawer
shadows.purpose: The docked document drawer lifting off the page.

motion.name: ease-out
motion.purpose: All transitions; the drawer enters over 260ms, controls over 120ms.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The single main action on a page, top right.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { height: 34px; padding: 0 14px; border-radius: 4px; border: 1px solid #14213a; background: #14213a; color: #fff; font-weight: 600; font-size: 14px; cursor: pointer; transition: background-color 120ms; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: #2a3f66; border-color: #2a3f66; } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #14213a; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Secondary Button
components.description: A supporting action next to a primary one.
components.css: .ds-btn { height: 34px; padding: 0 14px; border-radius: 4px; border: 1px solid #c7cedb; background: #fff; color: #16223a; font-weight: 600; font-size: 14px; cursor: pointer; transition: background-color 120ms; } .ds-btn:hover { background: #f3f5f9; border-color: #636c80; } .ds-btn:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #14213a; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Search Input
components.description: Filters a register by name or GSTIN.
components.html: <input class="ds-input" placeholder="Search by name or GSTIN" />
components.css: .ds-input { height: 34px; width: 250px; padding: 0 10px; border: 1px solid #c7cedb; border-radius: 4px; background: #fff; color: #16223a; font-size: 14px; } .ds-input:hover { border-color: #636c80; } .ds-input:focus-visible { outline: none; border-color: #14213a; box-shadow: 0 0 0 1px #14213a; }

components.name: Nav Item
components.description: A destination in the navy rail; the active one is raised.
components.css: .ds-nav { display: flex; align-items: center; height: 36px; padding: 0 11px; border-radius: 4px; color: #b4bdd0; font-weight: 600; font-size: 14px; transition: background-color 120ms, color 120ms; } .ds-nav:hover { background: #1b2b49; color: #fff; } .ds-nav-active, .ds-nav-active:hover { background: #243a62; color: #fff; }

components.name: Status Badge
components.description: Names a state in words, tinted by that state.
components.css: .ds-badge { display: inline-block; padding: 1px 8px; border: 1px solid; border-radius: 4px; font-size: 13px; font-weight: 600; line-height: 1.5; } .ds-badge-ok { background: #e7f3ed; color: #0a6e4b; border-color: #b9dac9; } .ds-badge-warn { background: #fbf1db; color: #85560a; border-color: #e9d09a; }

components.name: Readiness Bar
components.description: A client's documents as validated, review, failed and pending segments.
components.css: .ds-bar { display: flex; gap: 2px; width: 132px; height: 8px; } .ds-bar span { flex-basis: 0; min-width: 4px; border-radius: 2px; }

narrative.overview: Patra looks like the books-of-account software an accountant already trusts: a ruled register of clients, one row each, with a bar showing how many of that client's documents are validated, in review, failed or pending. The screen is organised around the work, not around a metrics dashboard.
keyCharacteristics: One flat surface type, the panel, with a 1px rule and no shadow.
State colour is the only decoration, and each state also has a text label.
Figures are tabular; identifiers are mono; nothing else is.

rules.name: The State-Only Colour Rule
rules.body: Green, amber, red and slate mean validated, review, failed and pending, nowhere else. Brand and actions are navy.

rules.name: The Label Beside the Colour Rule
rules.body: A state is never colour alone: the badge, bar tooltip or row text always says it in words.

rules.name: The Tabular Rule
rules.body: Every table and total uses tabular numerals so columns of rupees align.

rules.name: The No Shouting Rule
rules.body: No uppercase tracked labels. Hierarchy comes from weight and size.

rules.name: The Border-or-Shadow Rule
rules.body: A surface has a 1px border or a shadow, never both. Panels use the border.

dos: Do lead a document's overview with its review reason when it is flagged.
Do keep one primary button per page and put it top right.
Do show "Not recorded" or "Not found" when a value is missing, never a plausible default.
Do format rupees with Indian grouping (₹1,42,350) and tabular numerals.
donts: Don't add stat-card rows, avatar initials, gradient fills or decorative icon tiles.
Don't use green, amber or red for anything but state.
Don't add controls whose backend does not exist yet; leave them out until they work.
Don't use uppercase tracked micro-labels or emoji.
